title: DeleLuz webapp V1
brief: End-user phone webapp for the LEDDMX-03 strip: Thumb First base with scene preview before apply, page-only off timer, symptom help with Reconnect; neon/glass style; honest about device limits.

artboards.title: Glow Glass
artboards.tradeoff: Frosted violet-magenta glass, closest to the references; separate power button and bottom brightness card. Glass blur costs some performance on older phones.
